prompt: Create ONE separate book illustration of John, the real man in the photographic references, for The Vegetable Guru. Preserve his recognisable likeness: receding hairline with wispy short grey-brown hair at the sides, high forehead, short salt-and-pepper beard and moustache, gentle eyes, friendly understated smile, ordinary proportions. Faithful middle-aged-to-older adult face, not a caricature or generic garden mascot. Clothing follows the source: open muted red/cream/navy checked shirt, plain olive T-shirt, olive shorts; omit recording microphone and logos. Translate people, clothes, tools and plants into one coherent polished, dimensional vector-like drawn style governed by the approved vegetable hero references: bold simplified silhouettes, broad overlapping colour and shadow planes, natural skin colours, rich lime/forest foliage with sparse cream tapered highlights. No black contour outlines, no stippling, no etched/pencil texture, no watercolour, no photographic texture, no glossy plastic skin. Simplify shirt checks to broad clean lines. Keep hands anatomically plausible and natural, with readable finger grips. Show only a small garden/greenhouse vignette to establish context: a short section of bed, a few recognisable plants, perhaps part of a greenhouse frame. Surrounding space and gaps must be truly transparent, not white or dark haze. NO rectangular scene background, no sky or full greenhouse, no lettering, no border. Complete silhouette with clear padding on every side, no cropped head, elbows, tools or leaf tips. Large high resolution. Reference 1 supplies John's real crouching tomato-picking activity; reference 2 is the authoritative face and clothing likeness. References 3–4 govern botanical drawing style. Show John in a natural three-quarter side view crouching beside a tomato plant, selecting a ripe fruit with one hand, steadying a colander already containing three tomatoes beside his knee with the other. His attentive face is visible in three-quarter profile looking at the fruit. Natural lowered shoulder and bent knees, stable weight. Reduce surrounding foliage to one readable staked tomato plant and a short irregular earth patch/bed edge, perhaps two faint greenhouse frame segments. Keep every fingertip and elbow and both shoes intact. Landscape 3:2 canvas with at least 8% clear transparent margins; smaller complete vignette, not a tightly cropped figure. No large background structure. Separate illustration.
